status_effects.explanation: Elstir is mildly and locally distinguished from the indifferent crowd by his implied genuine grief at Verdurin's death.
Locally diminished by the narrator's ironic portrait of her aging body and effortful performance of enthusiasm, which undercuts her attempted brilliance and wit.

appraisal_events.evidence: "toute mort est pour les autres une simplification d'existence... elle les rendit heureux. Toutefois, comme je l'ai dit, ce n'est pas ainsi que la mort de M. Verdurin avait été accueillie par Elstir."
appraisal_events.explanation: Against the backdrop of the mondain crowd treating others' deaths as a convenient relief, the narrator singles out Elstir as having reacted differently to M. Verdurin's death, implying a depth of genuine feeling that quietly sets him apart from the callous majority.

appraisal_events.evidence: "la princesse de Guermantes répéter d'un air exalté et d'une voix de ferraille que lui faisait son râtelier... mi-amusé, mi-s'excusant de ne pouvoir soutenir la gaîté longtemps, mais jusqu'au bout elle était décidée à « participer », à « faire clan »."
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator's description gently undercuts the princesse's performed vivacity by foregrounding the physical marks of old age (a voice altered by dentures) beneath her effortful gaiety, ironizing her strained attempt to seem youthfully 'in' with fashionable slang.
